The linked live report observed `gateway status --require-rpc --timeout 30000` completing after approximately 62 seconds under macOS host pressure. The repair forwards the existing bound through launchd read probes with timeout + `SIGKILL`, leaves lifecycle mutations unchanged, and replaces the serial required-status/auth probes with one read-only status connection that preserves accepted-hello auth/server/version metadata.
